scope: Read-only static audit of pinned El Cap provider and 4331/43224 children; no runtime or RF claims.

4331.behavior: version=1; state=4 only when IO80211Interface::linkState()==2; otherwise successful return with state left zero
4331.implication: state zero does not prove no association attempt

43224.behavior: version=1; state=4 only when IO80211Interface::linkState()==2; otherwise successful return with state left zero
43224.implication: state zero does not prove no association attempt

4331.implication: when gates fail, no BSSID bytes are written by the WLC query

43224.implication: when gates fail, no BSSID bytes are written by the WLC query

field_identity.bsscfg+0x0b: cfg->associated, corroborated by assertions at 0x25bc8 and 0x26db6
field_identity.bsscfg+0x0a: AP/BSS configuration branch byte; set path follows AP-specific cleanup when nonzero

4331.result: skipped or issued command result is ignored; local auth/interface fields are cleared; returns zero

43224.driver_wlc_identity: wlcStart stores _wlc_attach return in both this+0x418 and this+0x420 at 0x2f95..0x2fad

field_identity.wlc+0x3b: lifecycle byte; set at assoc_scan_complete and join_adopt_bss; recomputed from wlc+0x10ec != 0 in disassociate_client/bsscfg_disable
field_identity.wlc+0x2f: AP-lifecycle guard; written on AP doiovar paths at 0xa78a8 and 0xa7cfd

43224.result: skipped or issued command result is ignored; local IBSS/interface fields are cleared; returns zero

counterevidence_to_zero_bssid_equivalenc: GET_BSSID may skip its query and leave bytes untouched when the driver's gates fail.
4331 has a separate association context at bsscfg+0x320; bsscfg_down checks its +0x0c state and can call _wlc_assoc_abort, while setDISASSOCIATE does not inspect it.
43224 SET_DISASSOCIATE reads WLC lifecycle/AP bytes and does not inspect the current record's BSSID.
Both setters return zero on skipped and ignored-command paths while still performing local cleanup.
conclusion: Both children have zero-return command-skip paths. Static evidence does not establish that an all-zero or unavailable BSSID is sufficient to select a safe already-unassociated/no-join-in-flight no-op across both children.
